tools.name: check_subcontractor_right_to_work_duty
tools.description: UK only. Says whether a business must do a right to work check on a subcontractor, gig worker or platform worker under the rule in force from 1 October 2026 (Border Security, Asylum and Immigration Act 2025, s48), and what to do. Free. General information, not legal advice.

tools.name: how_to_do_a_right_to_work_check
tools.description: UK only. Returns the three accepted ways to check someone's right to work, what records to keep and for how long, and the fines. Free.
